profile.bio: 14+ years in M  Electricity Discom leadership.
Assistant Engineer with 12 years of service in MP West Zone Electricity Discom.

15 years experience in Indore Discom as a Assistant Engineer and MPVMAVAKS union joined in 2014.  

Shajapur District president - 2014to 2014
State secretary - 2017 to 2021
State vice president -2021 to 2024
State President - Nov.-2024 to continue..
Focused on smart metering infrastructure deployment, revenue protection, and union member welfare.
Active engineer in distribution operations. Contributing to union technical welfare workshops and lineman safety.
Overseeing primary sub-station SCADA automation and technical training programs for junior engineering staff.
16+ years frontline maintenance of distribution transformers and transmission lines in Ratlam circle.
Managing rural electrification feeds, feeder separation projects, and grievance resolution for Dhar circle staff.
Specializing in emergency breakdown restoration, 11kV line patrolling, and substation maintenance.
Senior engineer with 25+ years in Madhya Pradesh power utilities. Guiding union technical submissions and policy dialogues.
Handling division accounts, audit compliance, staff payroll, and union financial transparency reports.
Coordinating youth outreach, apprentice rights advocacy, and employee welfare drives across Indore corporate offices.
